description:
This game is called Coup, a bluffing game. Each player has 2 hidden influence cards and 2 coins. On your turn, declare an action (some claim a role). Others can challenge your claim or block. Caught bluffing = lose a life (reveal a card). Wrong challenge = challenger loses a life. Last player standing wins.

ACTIONS:
- 'income': Take 1 coin. Cannot be challenged or blocked.
- 'foreign_aid': Take 2 coins. Can be blocked by Duke.
- 'tax': Claim Duke, take 3 coins. Can be challenged.
- 'steal NAME': Claim Captain, take 2 coins from NAME. Can be challenged. Can be blocked by Captain or Ambassador.
- 'assassinate NAME': Claim Assassin, pay 3 coins, target loses a life. Can be challenged. Can be blocked by Contessa.
- 'exchange': Claim Ambassador, draw 2 cards from court deck. If unchallenged or you win the challenge, you then enter a Choose phase: from your hand + the 2 drawn cards (3 or 4 cards total), choose which N to keep (where N is your current number of influence cards). Use 'keep CARD' (1 influence) or 'keep CARD1 CARD2' (2 influence). Returned cards go back to the deck. Can be challenged.
- 'coup NAME': Pay 7 coins, target loses a life. Cannot be challenged or blocked. MANDATORY if you have 10+ coins.

RESPONSE PHASE: After a declaration, other players choose 'challenge', 'block', or 'pass'.
- If challenged: declarer proves they have the claimed card. If they do, challenger loses a life. If not, declarer loses a life and action cancelled.
- If blocked (no challenge): action cancelled.
- If all pass: action takes effect.

Card types: Duke, Assassin, Captain, Ambassador, Contessa (3 copies each, 15 total). Lose both cards = eliminated.

Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Be the last player with influence remaining. Bluff strategically, challenge wisely, and eliminate your opponents.

role_secrets.Player: Your influence cards will be revealed privately at the start of the game.
